hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/prince-gallitzin-state-park/stay ('Some sites have full-hookup, which includes sewer, water, and electricity') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880311 (182 public sites list 50-amp, 64 list 30-amp; the 53 Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 390 campsites on the booking site (193 Modern Electric, 144 Modern Non-Electric, 53 Full-Hookup) across seven loops of 43-84 sites, besides cabins and cottages; DCNR says 398 sites, all paved. Listed max vehicle lengths run about 40-65 ft; two sites list 109 and 118 ft (198 Hemlock, 410 Main), left out of max_rig_ft as likely driveway figures. Two are pull-through.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/prince-gallitzin-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880311 (site list and each site's details page) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Each loop has its own shower house. The camp store has coin-operated laundry. Wi-Fi in the Crooked Run Campground is for a fee. Some loops close in spring and fall.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/prince-gallitzin-state-park/stay ('Camp store with coin-operated laundry', 'Showers', 'Flush toilets', 'Sanitary dump stations', 'Wi-Fi within the Crooked Run Campground for a fee'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/prince-gallitzin-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880311 (Booking Window for Full-Hookup, Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to late October) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 53 full-hookup sites, 390 campsites to ~65 ft with pull-throughs, showers, flush toilets, dump, camp store, laundry, paid Wi-Fi. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
